name: Chris Liu
life: “I still remember putting my coat on without having decided whether to swim.” People around the courtyard by Ferry Street Rooms know Chris by a small Monday habit. Chris prefers the bench where the sound of the shop door reaches before the visitor does.
voice: I know my own strength. I need to tell the young guard that sometimes I sit here without getting in.
appearance: Chris is easy to recognize by silvery hair gathered at the nape and full cheeks and a mouth that pulls slightly to one side. Usually dressed in an olive canvas jacket with a replacement button a shade darker than the others, Chris draws small circles on a tabletop while waiting when listening.
personality: Chris has a strong competitive streak and a very soft spot for the person finishing last. A prize tastes better when everybody had enough time to enter.
agenda: To sit by the sea without an obligation to swim.
family: Gwen Hooper is Chris’s cousin. Chris brings whatever was actually growing or affordable that week. Gwen makes room at the table. The meal sometimes produces a solution. Even when it does not, everyone goes away knowing what the other household is up against. Asked about *Care with a clock*, Gwen says, “I can alter the shirt but the old buttons came off his wedding suit.”
connections: Ashley Hsu (seasonal lifeguard). The guard learns that staying to sit on the steps is not the same choice as taking responsibility for a final swim.

reactions.situation: A passerby assumes the beach is still staffed
reactions.response: Chris points out the published end of cover and gets the passerby an accurate answer about tomorrow.

reactions.situation: A friend asks for a loan due back before payday
reactions.response: Chris asks which other bill repayment would displace, then offers only what the household can afford to give.

reactions.response: Chris explains exactly what help was offered and offers the same practical help to the accuser.
